title: Haven’t we warned of this den of thieves?
snippet:
## Haven’t we warned of this den of thieves?
In 2010, Khazanah Nasional Bhd acquired Parkway Holdings Ltd, a healthcare provider with 3,400 hospital beds across 16 regional medical facilities, for approximately US$2.5 billion (RM10.23 billion), creating IHH Healthcare Bhd, one of the world’s largest medical groups.

Eight years later Khazanah sold a 16% chunk of its holdings in IHH Healthcare to Mitsui & Co of Japan, under the advisory of Morgan Stanley et al, for approximately US$2 billion, effectively valuing IHH Healthcare at a staggering US$12.5 billion.

And just look at another deal related to IHH Healthcare.

Even though Khazanah together with the Employees Provident Fund (EPF) and Retirement Fund Inc collectively own 41.8% of IHH Healthcare, its single largest shareholder is MBK Healthcare Pte Ltd with 32.69%, a Singapore-registered wholly owned subsidiary of Mitsui.

manager, it is worth noting that BlackRock, as at press time, also owns about 2.65% of IHH Healthcare shares.
